sections.title: Materials and Methods, proseminar in CLASSICAL STUDIES AND ANCIENT HISTORY
sections.description: This is the required proseminar for first-year graduate students in Classical Studies and Ancient History. It offers an up-to-date orientation to the professional academic fields conventionally known as classical studies and ancient history. The course is responsive to present debates within, and about, these fields.
